question: Does smooth position reanchoring preserve the lifting recovery benefit without an instantaneous reference jump?
reference: Position goal interpolates linearly from the last registered goal to actual entry EEF position over .25 s of simulated waiting. The first control command at elapsed=0 retains the registered target. Both wrists retain the original registered orientation target in all conditions; grippers and gains are identical. No physical state editing.
freeze: Exact prior CAD source/config; development checks numerical execution, interpolation endpoints and prefix matching only. No task/model/threshold tuning or favorable seed replacement.
primary: Native Y500 at unchanged 100 ms support and 10 mm penetration guards; raw C, Y20, first dual grasp, full all-attempt time and retries reported.

statistics.unit: whole initialization seed retaining both fault sides and all hold/wait cells
contrasts: smooth minus registered at long wait
smooth by wait minus registered by wait
smooth minus immediate position at long wait

stopping: Complete exactly 360 formal runs after development/freeze. No role-only or offset scans. Retain all attempts and disclose initialization/runtime failures.
